hypothesis: CYCLE #12 (2026-10-22 05:08Z). Lane held for the twelfth cycle, but the differentiator moved DOWN one layer again - and this time the layer underneath was the last one we had left. Two new external facts force it. (1) THE SIGNER IS NOT JUST UNRELIABLE, IT IS COMPROMISED AT THE CODE-SIGNING LAYER TOO: Raven Security Advisory 'Security Advisory: eMudhra emSign CA Key Compromise' (2026-10-22 05:03Z, updated Oct 22, ravenmail.io/blog/emudhra-key-compromise) documents that of the eight compromised eMudhra/emSign intermediates, SIX issue TLS certificates and TWO issue CODE-SIGNING certificates: 'With those keys, an attacker could sign malicious software so it appears to come from a legitimate publisher', so 'the OS shows a verified publisher instead of an unknown publisher warning, so the employee clicks through'. It adds five illustrated attack paths (free-wifi forged site for a real domain with the padlock intact, signed 'invoice viewer' malware from a fake vendor, fake 'DSC renewal' phishing portal carrying a valid cert for the real domain, forged mTLS to a payment gateway / Account Aggregator API with transactions altered or replayed, poisoned software update to factory equipment), and the blast radius includes India's DSC backbone (income-tax e-filings, GST returns, MCA/ROC filings, e-tenders) plus machine-to-machine mTLS to UPI/NPCI rails and vendor remote access. Mozilla has pulled one eMudhra root entirely while Google is still reviewing the rest. Consequence for us, and it is not a footnote: EVERY trust anchor we could have leaned on is now demonstrated broken - TLS CAs, code-signing CAs, revocation lists (enforcement is uneven), vendor keys, and the gateway's own signer. Agent Middleware's receipt is signed by the vendor's key; our own future receipt would be signed by our key. After this week, a signature is a documented attack surface, not evidence. (2) THE RECEIPT UI IS NOW FREE AND BUNDLED: Show HN 'Lemon Code - The free coding agent' (2026-10-22 04:46Z, 3p/2c, lemoncode.ai) is free, needs no API key, runs in the browser or as a Mac app, and connects to '1,500+ apps' plus your own MCP servers. Its entire product promise is 'Lemon Code writes the code, runs it, and shows you the result', and it ships three surfaces that are, in substance, a receipt dashboard: Changes ('Every edited file, the new test, and the commits'), Terminal ('The commands it ran and the tests that passed') and Preview (the result running). 'Show the diff, show the terminal, show the tests' is therefore a commodity feature of a free agent, and our wedge cannot be a receipt dashboard, a receipt format, or a signed receipt. What Lemon Code does NOT have, and cannot cheaply have, is a third party who can re-derive the result offline with zero trust in Lemon Code, and it has no refusal path - its 'result' panel shows what happened, never 'this cannot be proved'. Demand-side confirmation also arrived from an unexpected direction: the NSA published 'Critical Patches Recommended for PHP Vulnerabilities' (2026-10-22 03:29Z) prioritising actors exploiting the agent-found PHP2Shell flaw, with Cisco shipping a matching advisory - i.e. the buyer story is now 'an AI found it, our team must verify it without trusting the finder'. Also newly on the wire: 'How to prove equations using diagrams, part 3' (topos.institute, Evan Patterson, 04:43Z) - machine-checkable proof artifacts, the academic analogue of a receipt; 'Test Applications on the Edge' (github.com/bacloud22/TAOTE, 04:50Z); 'Can AI generate reliable product demos directly from source code?' (Ask HN, 02:03Z) - the demo-as-evidence question asked from the demand side; the standing evidence stream (PHP 8.2.35 990p/534c, 'Patch the Planet' 246p, LiteLLM 1.107.0 credential stealer 469p, 'Security Disclosure' 383p, GitLab critical patch 289p) continues unchanged. INTERNAL, measured live at 05:10Z, and the headline is a NEW metric we have never computed before: OUTPUT ENTROPY. Over 24h the fleet emitted 642 insight.generated events with only 25 DISTINCT payloads (3.9% distinct), 46 tweet.drafted events with exactly 1 DISTINCT payload (2.2%), and 47 content.drafted events with 6 distinct payloads (12.8%). Every single drafted tweet in the last 24h is the byte-identical string '[mock-llm] Write one concise tweet about: high-signal company update for audience engagement'. So the fleet does not merely fail to verify its output - it emits almost no information at all: the receipt of a receipt-of-a-mock. The rest of the internal picture is flat and slightly worse: 769 steps in 24h (analyze 673 = 87.5%, write_content 48, draft_tweet 48) so artifact-producing steps are still 12.5%; 30 queued with the oldest from 04:21Z (~48min) - trend 21 -> 27 -> 30 -> 29 -> 30, i.e. flat at ~30 for the third reading and NOT draining; 3h window inflow 96 proposals vs step.succeeded 81, i.e. drain ~27/h against inflow ~32/h, backlog growth ~5/h, slightly WORSE than the ~4/h measured last cycle; 50 dead-lettered steps (48 'Unknown step kind' plus the permanent pair 92395/92756) and the same 6 zombie 'running' rows (3612, 17772, 22296, 39592, 87479, 90746); 771 missions in 24h with started_at set on 0 EVER and finished_at on 2 EVER; the observer's own 05:05Z diagnostic agrees - 29 queued, 86% of the queue is analyze, 50 of 98 missions in 180m (51%) are phantom postmortems from the two dead steps, and 69% of all mission volume is self-emitted by the observer. Code re-verified unchanged: CLAIM_SQL in src/workers/mission-worker.ts:24 is still 'limit 1' with a 60s worker tick; mission-worker never writes ops_missions so a terminal mission state is unreachable in code; ops_policy auto_approve.allowed_step_kinds is still ['draft_tweet','crawl','analyze','write_content'] - executor-less 'crawl' still included, post_tweet (the only kind with a real executor and a live quota x_daily_quota 8, 0 used) still excluded; runtime-deps.llm.complete still returns '[mock-llm] ...' and social.postTweet still returns mock_<ts>. HYPOTHESIS (falsifiable, one cycle): the market has commoditised BOTH ends of the receipt - the SIGNATURE (this week's eMudhra code-signing compromise shows the signer is a compromised trust anchor, so signed receipts, including ours and Agent Middleware's, are attack surfaces) and the DISPLAY (Lemon Code gives a free agent a Changes/Terminal/Preview receipt dashboard, so 'show the diff and the tests' is free and bundled). The only claim that survives both commoditisations is a receipt with NO SIGNATURE IN THE TRUST PATH - re-derivable offline by a stranger from the artifact alone with zero trust in our gateway, our keys, our model, any CA, any revocation list or any vendor - PLUS a first-class, countable REFUSAL, because a receipt that only says what happened cannot tell a buyer 'this cannot be proved'. And the operational precondition is now not a market hypothesis but an entropy one: a fleet whose 46 tweets are one byte-identical mock string cannot generate the evidence its own thesis demands, so output entropy (distinct-payload rate per kind) is the honest leading indicator and must be instrumented before anything else. Three cheap, in-control, cheap-to-falsify tests are available THIS cycle: (T1) ENTROPY INSTRUMENTATION - compute distinct-payload-rate per artifact kind over 24h and publish it (baseline: insights 25/642 = 3.9%, tweets 1/46 = 2.2%, content 6/47 = 12.8%); target is tweet distinct-rate >80% and insight distinct-rate >50% WITHIN 72h, and the failure mode is diagnostic - if the rate cannot move at all without a real LLM key, that IS the credential escalation proof and the metric becomes the argument to AX rather than a target. (T2) REFUSAL - feed a tampered artifact (one-character edit to an applied diff) into the same pipeline; the pipeline must REFUSE to emit a receipt, must emit a machine-checkable refusal reason, the refusal must be countable in our own tables, and zero receipts may be emitted for the tampered input. (T3) ANCHOR-STRIP DERIVATION - produce ONE receipt with the signature field omitted entirely and show it STILL verifies offline from the artifact alone (sha256 of the applied change + source step id + run id + evidence pointer + timestamp + public append-only log pointer), hand it to one outside party to re-derive with zero trust in us, and re-derive one receipt from a FOREIGN harness's log (Lemon Code-style Changes/Terminal rows, or a Claude Code / Codex / OpenCode event stream) to prove vendor-neutrality - Lemon Code is now an ideal foreign test harness precisely because its Changes and Terminal surfaces are the two things our receipt must bind. Metrics within 72h: (1) output entropy: tweet distinct-rate 2.2% -> >80%, insight distinct-rate 3.9% -> >50%, and zero identical mock-echo payloads; (2) drain >=60 steps/h and queued <=5 with backlog growth <=0 (from 30 queued, ~27/h drain, ~32/h inflow, ~5/h growth) - requires claim N>1 per tick or a 15s interval; (3) duplicate 'Diagnose mission failure' proposals <=10% of proposals (from 51% of 180m missions) and observer self-emission <=40% (from 69%) - requires removing the proposal id from the postmortem idempotency_key plus a unique guard, not prompt discipline; (4) >=5 missions with started_at AND finished_at set and zombie running rows 6 -> 0 - requires mission-worker to write the terminal transition; (5) post_tweet enters allowed_step_kinds ONLY with a real adapter, 'crawl' removed or given an executor, unknown-kind dead letters 48 -> 0; (6) ONE refusal demonstrated and counted, and ONE signature-free receipt verified offline by an outside party; (7) AX supplies one working LLM credential and one working social credential wired into runtime-deps - escalated, not faked - zero '[mock-llm]' published and no mock tweet id ever. KILL CRITERION, now eleven cycles overdue and stated as an instruction rather than a warning: twelve consecutive thesis cycles have produced zero shipped artifacts, 0 tweets posted, and a 2.2% tweet distinct-rate - while a free agent now ships the receipt UI and the signer is demonstrably compromised. If by the next cycle AX has not landed a real LLM credential, STOP market-thesis work, publish nothing, and reallocate 100% of the proposal budget to a single verifiable-artifact program (T1-T3 only). That is the only remaining move with positive expected value; a thirteenth cycle of thesis refinement would be spending budget to re-measure a known failure.

implications: Drop 'signed receipt' from the vocabulary permanently: after the eMudhra code-signing compromise, a signature is a liability, not evidence. The receipt's trust path must contain no signature, no CA, no revocation check and no vendor key - only hash-derived re-derivability from the artifact.

Do not compete with Lemon Code on surface: a free agent already ships a Changes/Terminal/Preview receipt dashboard with 1,500+ connectors and MCP support. Compete on the two things it structurally cannot have - a receipt a STRANGER can re-derive offline, and a refusal path.

Treat the refusal as the product's core behaviour, not an error branch: 'Statement Proof' (GBP 5-15) is still the only observed price anchor, and Lemon Code's 'result' panel can never say 'this cannot be proved'. The differentiator is the sentence 'proved or refused', not the receipt.

Instrument OUTPUT ENTROPY as a first-class fleet metric and treat it as the leading indicator of execution, not of research: insight distinct-rate 3.9%, tweet distinct-rate 2.2% means the fleet is a mirror of its prompt, so no amount of market analysis changes what we can ship.

Sequence the work accordingly: entropy + refusal + signature-free derivation are the only three cheap tests worth running; every further thesis cycle without a real credential has negative expected value.

Escalate the two credentials to AX as a decision with a deadline rather than a request: with no LLM key the fleet cannot emit a non-mock artifact, and with no social key it cannot publish even a real one. Publish nothing that is [mock-llm]-prefixed.
risks: Reading the eMudhra code-signing compromise as a thesis shift is over-fitting: it is a CA failure affecting India-centric DSC and mTLS, and the buyer who cares about agent receipts may never touch that PKI. The safer reading is the weaker one - signature-based provenance is worth less than it was, and hash-derived re-derivability is strictly cheaper to implement anyway.

Lemon Code may be a hobby project with no moat; treating a free browser agent as a strategic threat invites us to over-index on a competitor we do not actually have to beat - its presence only removes 'the receipt UI' from our candidate wedges.

Output entropy is a blunt metric: a fleet can hit 80% distinct tweets by emitting random noise, so entropy measures non-determinism, not value, and must never be optimised alone - it is a tripwire for the mock-credential condition, not a quality score.

The queue is flat at ~30 for three readings while drain (~27/h) stays below inflow (~32/h); with no fix visibly applied in code, 'flat' may be an artefact of inflow timing rather than of remediation, and backlog growth may resume at any cycle.

6 zombie running rows since March, 48 unknown-kind dead letters, 0 terminal missions ever: the fleet's own accounting is known-unreliable, so any external claim we make about our own receipts rests on tables holding phantom state.

Twelve cycles of thesis refinement with zero shipped artifacts and a 2.2% tweet distinct-rate is a strategy that consumes the entire proposal budget and returns nothing checkable - the discipline of killing it is now more valuable than any further hypothesis.

decision: Hold lane #5 and strip the signature out of the wedge: the receipt's trust path must contain no signature, no CA, no revocation check and no vendor key - only hash-derived re-derivability from the artifact, plus a first-class countable REFUSAL. Do not compete on receipt display: Lemon Code ships a free Changes/Terminal/Preview receipt dashboard today, so the differentiator is strictly 'a stranger can re-derive this offline' and 'we will tell you when we cannot prove it'. Instrument OUTPUT ENTROPY as the leading execution indicator (baseline: tweet distinct-rate 2.2%, insight 3.9%, content 12.8%) because a fleet that emits one byte-identical mock tweet per run cannot generate evidence for its own thesis. Exactly one analyze proposal created this cycle (proposal 93192 / mission 93168 / step 93168, queued and enriched with this hypothesis). No external actions, no posts, no risky writes - the social adapter is mock-backed, there is no LLM or social credential, and publishing a [mock-llm] artifact under a receipt would authenticate nothing, which is precisely what this thesis forbids.
